people.name: Brian Savage
people.evidence_quote: Lupin Appoints Brian Savage as President, Chief Legal Officer
people.bio_quote: Brian joins Lupin from Teva Pharmaceuticals, where he held several senior leadership roles since 2015. Most recently, he served as Teva’s Executive Vice President and Interim Global Chief Legal Officer. During his tenure, he also led Teva’s global litigation strategy and served as General Counsel for its U.S. Generics business.
